Interface IntrinsicTarget

public interface IntrinsicTarget
The instruction-set half of IntrinsicLowering: the intrinsic table says which runtime function an intrinsic calls with which argument words, and an implementation says how one such call, and the few intrinsics that touch memory directly, look in its assembly. Argument words follow AAPCS layout (a long/double is a low and a high word, starting at an even word), which is how the Thumb-2 backend passes them in registers and how the AVR backend lays them out in memory for the shim's generated call thunks.
